# Mano Sivanandan, Cross-Functional Product Manager & Forward Deployed Engineer

> Mano Sivanandan is a cross-functional Product Manager with forward deployed engineering (FDE) skills. Mano works across customers, sales, operations and engineering to ship and integrate customer-facing products in insurance, logistics, health, school transport and hiring.

## Skills
- Public speaking: conference plenary talks for business audiences
- Customer enablement: hands-on AI agents and vibe coding workshops
- Cross-functional leadership: aligning customers, sales, operations and engineering
- Forward deployed engineering: hands-on builds and integrations alongside customers
- Product discovery and strategy: turning vague asks into a clear problem, a roadmap and success metrics
- Customer experience (CX) design across customer, broker and operations journeys
- CRM and support systems: Zoho CRM and Zoho Desk integration
- Data and metrics: testing claims against real data, writing metric specs
- Web and mobile prototyping: React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Expo (Android and iOS)

## Product management portfolio
- [Nexora Logistics](https://github.com/manosivanandan-ai/NexoraLogistics): logistics CX platform with quote wizard, shipment tracking, customer portal and Zoho CRM integration
- [TerraShield Insurance](https://github.com/manosivanandan-ai/TerraShieldInsurance): two-sided insurance platform for customers and brokers
- [Hiring pipeline audit](https://github.com/manosivanandan-ai/PM-Assignment-ByMano-forMyOperator): PM case study with a roadmap and an offer-acceptance metrics spec, built on live Airtable data
- [DestinationReminder](https://github.com/manosivanandan-ai/DestinationReminder): Android and iOS arrival-alarm app using background GPS
- [Milo, my everyday coach](https://github.com/manosivanandan-ai/PersonalWeightlossCoach): weight-loss coaching app with daily score and nudges
- [School bus boarding tracker](https://github.com/manosivanandan-ai/SNPV-Park63-BusApp): community app for tracking children boarding a school bus
- [Health First](https://github.com/manosivanandan-ai/Healthfirst): product and venture pitch for a nutrition brand
